answer: Quorum attestation by independent notaries requires a threshold of licensed notaries to co-sign an identity claim, and the vault of the mechanism is that notaries are audited and their keys are public. The oasis of the design is that each notary checks a different piece of evidence, so no single notary can approve a fake identity alone. A Sybil would need to corrupt a quorum of audited professionals, and the shale of the audit trail makes any corrupt attestation traceable to its source.
